{{Use dmy dates|date=January 2020}}
{{Use British English|date=January 2020}}

'''John Lomas''' (1920–2019) was an RAF intelligence officer during the Second World War, when he decoded German communications at [[Bletchley Park]].  After the war, he became a senior officer in the [[UK Immigration Service|Immigration Service]].<ref name=Times/><ref name=TLH/>
